recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. Do not reintroduce local DICOM vocabulary copies in core; future stricter DICOM conformance should proceed through II/THO or IG-specific work rather than this Security R5 correction.
issue_request: FHIR-24908 was Published/Persuasive for R5 and requested that DICOM-managed vocabularies and value sets used by AuditEvent and ImagingStudy be imported from DICOM rather than duplicated as hand-coded FHIR core terminology.
initial_application: The change was pre-applied by commit 26f1439636ec3a00a96ffe742b9f5cba1ac1a8ba and merged by af4f14dcdcd7dd3e7d3da15864963ab2a00e8010 as PR #951. That application updated AuditEvent, ImagingStudy, and shared terminology sources to use DICOM URI/value-set references and removed the local DICOM value-set files listed in the Jira comment.
additional_context: The Zulip thread linked from Jira confirms that tx.fhir.org could load DICOM value sets directly, that the DICOM value-set URLs were HTML-shaped but usable, and that the pre-apply worked. Security minutes tracked the issue as moving toward using DICOM terminology rather than self-crafted code systems. Current fhir.ini keeps AuditEvent and ImagingStudy active; current successor XML imports DICOM CIDs 400, 401, 403, 404, and 402 for AuditEvent-related value sets and binds ImagingStudy modality to DICOM CID 33. Later ImagingStudy context, especially FHIR-17279 and FHIR-47481, supports the current CID 33 binding and cautions against stricter baseline DICOM terminology constraints in core.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current authoritative XML already uses DICOM-published terminology for the relevant active bindings and no active source still depends on the removed local DICOM value sets. The only stale removed-value-set reference found is in source/genomicstudy/imagingstudy.svg, a generated-looking orphan outside active fhir.ini resource scope, so it is not an authoritative current-spec fix for this issue.

related_jiras.note: Published ImagingStudy issue confirming CID 33 as the modality value set; it is already represented on the combined branch and was used only as context.
Resolved - No Change R6 ImagingStudy ballot issue rejecting stricter baseline DICOM terminology bindings as too restrictive for core.
